strongest_angle: Examining Variety's October 2026 Horror Impact Report, which highlights key directors and actors like James Wan, Curry Barker, Naomi Ackie, and Na Hong-jin shaping the future of modern horror cinema.

key_facts.fact: Director James Wan was recognized in Variety's October 2026 Horror Impact Report as a key talent defining the genre.
Director Na Hong-jin, known for the film Hope, was selected for Variety's 2026 Horror Impact Report alongside filmmakers Sam Raimi and James Wan.
Variety released its second annual Horror Impact Report on October 7, 2026, crowning top directors and actors shaping modern horror.
